vb_textbox.text: I discovered the choice between a pointed and round hat, the pointed hat appears to provide more mushrooms. Between the purple and green colors, it alternates but the green color seems to do better. When I realized that the number for a particular color was going down, I changed to the alternative color sometimes it gets more mushrooms. Also, avoid sticking to one side as it seems to change to either left or right regardless of the color. Between the red and yellow hat, I think the yellow hard gets more mushrooms but it changes sometimes, so try not to concentrate on one side alone
